adaptationNotes: The effective FRAME is a Chinese knowledge-video adaptation; the original FRAME remains pinned as provenance instead of traveling as a second rule source.
Chinese display and explanatory roles use local Noto Serif SC and Noto Sans SC at weight 400; Latin display, body and catalog roles retain Newsreader, Hanken Grotesk and DM Mono.
The source zero-circle direction is limited to the editorial grid and panels so necessary curves in recognizable semantic objects remain available.
Pixel glitch and QR-like marks are optional series punctuation rather than mandatory decoration on every frame.
Motion is defined as deterministic measured-paper choreography without copying the source deck transition or the samples' subject matter.
Shared camera, text timing and continuity rules are owned by motion-direction; historical project reviews retain their original scope and do not approve this motion revision.

validationScope.basis: P9 same-content candidate and the maintained bank-run build are historical inputs; P28 adds a new-topic standard-mode bridge expansion-joint build
